messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout: service=redwood-api, version=v3.14.0, target=5% traffic, regions=[eu-west-1], started by @jen at 2024-11-04T14:12:01Z
jen: heads-up — rolling 5% to eu-west-1 now. watch latency & 5xx closely. release notes: https://internal/redwood/releases/v3.14.0 :rocket:
mike: watching logs — seeing a small cluster of tokenizer errors in eu-west-1, nothing yet in us-west. 5xx trending 0.4% -> 2.1% over last 3 minutes.
sarah: oof. can we pause or pin region-level traffic back to v3.13.2 while we triage? id rather limit blast than rollback globally.
jen: agree with sarah. proposal: PAUSE rollout, pin eu-west-1 to previous stable v3.13.2, keep canary snapshot for investigation. any objections? :thinking_face:
leo: +1 to pin. i'll grab a bisect and attach logs. quick root cause hypothesis: tokenizer lib mismatch with quantized model variant.
ops-bot: Suggested action commands:
```
# pause rollout
/deploy pause --service redwood-api --rollout 4298765432
# pin traffic for region
/deploy pin --service redwood-api --region eu-west-1 --version v3.13.2 --reason "tokenizer errors"
```
jen: executing pause now. will run the pin when pause confirmed.
jen: /deploy pause --service redwood-api --rollout 4298765432
deploy-bot: Rollout 4298765432: PAUSE acknowledged. current traffic frozen at 5% in eu-west-1.
mike: attaching tail of app logs (sanitized):
```
[2024-11-04T14:13:08Z] ERROR tokenizer: failed to map vocab id 10234 -> KeyError
[2024-11-04T14:13:09Z] ERROR request=12345 status=500 route=/v1/generate
```
leo: running bisect on image -> looks like packaging step bumped tokenizer submodule to v2.1.0. rollback candidate is v2.0.7 which is what v3.13.2 uses.
sarah: recommendation: pin eu-west-1 to v3.13.2, notify support & customers in EU about partial degraded availability, run canary repro locally.
jen: /deploy pin --service redwood-api --region eu-west-1 --version v3.13.2 --reason "tokenizer mismatch causing 5xx spike"
deploy-bot: Pin action queued. Applying pin to eu-west-1...
deploy-bot: Pin successful. eu-west-1 traffic now pinned to v3.13.2 (traffic bump/stable will be routed to pinned version). Rollout paused.
ops-bot: Notifying SRE & Support channels. Suggested follow-ups:
- run full regression tests on staging with tokenizer v2.1.0
- confirm packaging scripts & submodule pinning in CI
- prepare hotfix branch (v3.14.1) if root-cause confirmed
jen: tagging @oncall-sre and @support-eu. can someone draft a short customer-facing note? keep it conservative: partial EU instability, temporary pin, investigating.
mike: draft: "We're investigating increased 500 responses for some EU requests. We've temporarily pinned eu-west-1 to a stable version to limit impact. No global rollback. Updates to follow." ok?
sarah: lgtm. add ETA for next update in 30 mins.
jen: thanks. putting a 30-min timer. will update thread with RCA or rollback decision. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
leo: collecting artifacts, will post stack traces & CI diff in 10m.
jen: quick poll — proceed with global rollback to v3.13.2 if we see continued >1.5% 5xx for next 10m? react with :thumbsup: to auto-rollback, :thumbsdown: to keep pin-and-triage.
jen: :thumbsup: (5) :thumbsdown: (2)
jen: Note — ops policy will auto-rollback if threshold met and quorum reached. For now we stay pinned and triage.
deploy-bot: Rollout 4298765432: status=PAUSED, pin=eu-west-1->v3.13.2, notes="tokenizer errors observed"
jen: closing the loop — pausing notifications but keeping thread open. will update in 30. thanks all. :handshake:
